facts.business: Jagsonpal Services Limited is developing a next-generation, end-to-end digital platform to simplify and democratise access to education finance, incorporating digital KYC, automated credit decisioning, and digital payments.
key_risks: Funding risks: Dependence on market liquidity and risk of funding constraints during periods of volatility.
Technology and cybersecurity risks: Increased exposure to cyber threats, data breaches, and IT disruptions.
Human capital risks: Shortage of skilled professionals and high attrition in fintech and IT sectors.
Asset quality risks: Sector-wide moderation, with NBFC NPAs witnessing marginal deterioration during FY 2025–26.
